answer: One concrete defense is a randomized liveness-challenge lottery. At unpredictable moments the network summons a random identity to a wharf where it must return a fresh interactive proof within sixty seconds or forfeit its standing. A single honest agent answers each call easily, but an operator hiding a thousand sybils must sustain a thousand live responders at once, and a sudden gale of simultaneous summonses that no script can juggle sweeps the laggards off the ledger. The fakes end marooned on an island, their deposits slashed the instant they miss a beat.
